about.notSocial: SPECACT is not a social network. It is a network of personal content under your control: you own what you write, it lives in your own Google Drive, and only the people you name can open it.
banner.offline: You are offline. Showing what was saved on this device.
compose.keepPassword: Leave empty to keep the current password
compose.mentionHint: Type @ and a name or e-mail to mention someone — they get access to this post.
compose.noFriends: Add friends to pick them here, or type an e-mail below.
compose.passwordHint: At least 6 characters. Share it with your recipients separately — it cannot be recovered.
compose.passwordShort: The password needs at least 6 characters.
compose.protectFixed: Protection is chosen when a post is created and cannot be changed afterwards.
compose.protectLocked: This post is protected. You can set a new password below.
compose.skipped: {n} file(s) skipped. Images only, up to {max} per post and {mb} MB each.
creds.badId: That does not look like a Google client ID (…apps.googleusercontent.com).
creds.badSecret: Enter the client secret from the same credential.
creds.hint: SPECACT has no server. Create your own free Google OAuth client so the app talks only to your Google Drive.
creds.local: Stored only on this device, encrypted twice (device key + your PIN). Never sent to any server of ours.
creds.redirect: Authorized redirect URI — add exactly this
creds.step1: Create a project in the Google Cloud console:
creds.step3: OAuth consent screen → External. While it is in “Testing”, add your own address and every friend’s Gmail as test users.
creds.step4: Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application. Add the redirect URI and origin shown below.
creds.step5: Copy the client ID and client secret into the fields below.
creds.title: Your Google keys
demo.banner: Demo mode: sample people and posts, nothing is saved or sent. Password for the sealed post: specact
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.insecure: SPECACT needs a secure connection (HTTPS, or http://localhost) so your browser can encrypt your data. Please open it from an https:// address.
error.publish: Could not publish. Nothing was shared.
error.sync: Could not refresh from Google Drive.
friends.empty: No one here yet. Add a friend by e-mail to start sharing.
friends.name: Name
friends.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from your friends? They keep any access you already granted until you remove them from each post.
mention.empty: Add friends first, or type a full e-mail address.
notice.expired: Your Google session expired. Continue with Google to sign in again.
notice.invalidClient: Google rejected the client ID or secret. Check your keys.
notice.noRefresh: Google did not allow offline access. Remove SPECACT from your Google account permissions and try again.
notice.offlineFirst: You need to be online for the first sign-in.
notice.scope: Google Drive permission was not granted. SPECACT needs it to store and share posts.
notice.state: The sign-in could not be verified. Please try again.
notice.storage: This browser blocks local storage, so SPECACT cannot keep your keys safely.
pin.createHint: It unlocks SPECACT on this device. Your keys are encrypted with it and it never leaves the device.
pin.forgotConfirm: Erase everything stored by SPECACT on this device? Your posts in Google Drive are not touched — you can sign in again afterwards.
pin.mismatch: The PINs do not match. Start again.
pin.unlockHint: Your keys are locked on this device.
pin.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {n}s.
pin.weak: Too easy to guess. Avoid repeats and sequences.
pin.wiped: Too many wrong PINs. Local data was erased for your safety.
post.changePasswordHint: Set a new password. The old one stops working for new visitors.
post.forbidden: You do not have access to this post. Ask the owner to share it with your Google account.
post.forgetConfirm: Remove this post from your list? The owner’s copy is not affected.
post.likeDisabled: You can only react to posts you are allowed to comment on.
post.linkOn: Anyone with the link and the password
post.linkShareHint: Anyone signed in with Google who has the link and the password can read it.
post.linkShareNeedsPassword: Turn on password protection when writing the post to enable this.
rail.demo: Demo data — nothing is stored in Google Drive
settings.autoLockHint: Lock the app after this much inactivity.
settings.install: Install SPECACT as an app on this device
settings.keysHint: Client ID and secret, stored encrypted on this device.
settings.notifyHint: Google e-mails people when you share with them. Off = they just find it in Drive and in SPECACT.
settings.pinHint: {n} digits, required every time the app opens.
settings.resetConfirm: Erase your PIN, Google keys and cached data from this device? Posts in Google Drive are kept.
settings.resetHint: Erase the PIN, keys and cache stored on this device. Google Drive is untouched.
settings.resyncHint: Normally automatic. Use if something looks out of date.
settings.signOutConfirm: Sign out of Google on this device? Your PIN and keys stay, so signing back in is quick.
toast.keysChangedSignIn: Keys saved. Sign in with Google again.
toast.linkCopied: Link copied. Only people with access can open it.
toast.linkOn: Anyone with the link and password can open this post
update.ready: A new version of SPECACT is ready.
welcome.flow1: Create a {n}-digit PIN that locks everything on this device.
welcome.flow2: Paste your own Google OAuth keys — they never leave this device.
welcome.flow3: Sign in with Google. Posts are saved in a SPECACT folder in your Drive.
